name: SLAP Lesion of the Shoulder
definition: Injury of the superior glenoid labrum from anterior to posterior, sometimes involving the biceps anchor and causing pain or mechanical symptoms.

core: Labral/biceps provocative tests interpreted in context

investigations.principle: MRI/MR arthrography can evaluate labral pathology; findings require symptom correlation.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Arthroscopic repair or biceps procedures are selective and age/activity dependent.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amsa-Snayu phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Injury of the superior glenoid labrum from anterior to posterior, sometimes involving the biceps anchor and causing pain or mechanical symptoms.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
